style: black and white ink line art comic, manga style, clean bold outlines, cross-hatching for shadow, no color, pure white paper background, screentone dots, high contrast

elements.caption: Panel 1, wide shot: a young woman sits at a wooden desk late at night, writing in a notebook, a single desk lamp lighting the page
Panel 2, extreme close-up: her hand stops, the pen tip hovering just above the paper, a half-written sentence visible
Panel 3, medium shot: she lifts her head and looks toward the window, rain streaks running down the glass
Panel 4, close shot: outside, a man in a long coat holds an umbrella and stands still under a street lamp, heavy rain, seen through rain-covered glass
